title: He Made a Fire and the Whole Village Panicked
description: An Earth astronaut lands on a strange planetoid, gets welcomed by hooded locals, and then makes one tiny mistake with a lighter.
hook_note: Opens on a cosmic war-god striding across space with a flaming torch, screaming to kill and destroy - impossible not to look.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Mars, drama queen of the cosmos, and his one hobby is strolling the universe looking for people to murder.

segments.text: This is Mars, drama queen of the cosmos, and his one hobby is strolling the universe looking for people to murder.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Meanwhile a ship from Earth is parking on planetoid 206, completely unaware it just booked the worst vacation ever.

segments.text: Meanwhile a ship from Earth is parking on planetoid 206, completely unaware it just booked the worst vacation ever.

shots.speaker: Dick Warren
shots.line: This explodes my theory! Only human beings have made these. I'll take it back and try to decipher it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Enter a crowd of hooded purple guys. Their opener?

shots.speaker: Dick Warren
shots.line: I'm Dick Warren from Earth. I never suspected this planetoid was inhabited.

segments.text: I never suspected this planetoid was inhabited.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Big man Wad throws a feast, a girl named Ada serves the food raw, and our boy Dick decides these people simply must be taught fire.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: He flicks open his little monogrammed lighter. Bad. Idea.

shots.speaker: Ada
shots.line: They cannot stand the smallest flame! It draws the oxygen from their bodies and strangles them! I am different! Why, I don't know!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And right on cue, invisible to everyone, the god of war himself drops into the middle of the crowd.
